overview.oneLineTake: Post-election AI regulation fear just flipped a midterm rally into a Nasdaq correction, so treat this as a vol-expansion regime until the selloff shows a floor.
themes: AI/tech wipeout: Nasdaq slid into correction (~5.5%), QQQ closed 647.05 (-6.5%), SPY 733 (-4.4%). Roughly $2.3 to $2.5T of Nasdaq value gone; Mag7 lost about $1T. Worst tech session since 2020.
Midterm hangover: Wednesday's blue-wave relief reversed as Democrats flagged AI regulation and a national data-center moratorium. Tesla and SpaceX took heavy hits in a two-day Musk-linked selloff.
Haven bid: Treasuries jumped on the equity rout (10-year last print 4.9% as of Nov 4). Yen firmed; Asia futures gap lower into the open.
Policy and data: BoE delivered its first hike in three years; Fed's Hammack and Barkin still lean restrictive. ADP +86k; October payrolls due Friday.
risks: Follow-through into Asia/Europe and gap risk into the US open while AI/regulation headlines keep printing.
Vol expansion after a 4σ equity day; VIX jumped hardest since April.
Single-name AI/chip and data-center credit stress (Anthropic IPO skepticism, loan dumps) can keep dispersion elevated even if indexes stabilize.
